camera.reason: 48MP OIS main, 48MP ultrawide and a 12MP 5x periscope telephoto, with 4K120 Dolby Vision video.

performance.reason: Apple A18 Pro with a 6-core GPU sustains the heaviest games and ProRes video recording.

battery.reason: 4,685mAh gives a full day plus, though charging is about 20W wired.

display.reason: 6.9 inch LTPO OLED at 1 to 120Hz reaching 2,000 nits outdoors.

build.reason: Grade 5 titanium frame, Ceramic Shield front and textured glass back, IP68 at 6 metres.

software.reason: Apple commits to at least 5 years of security updates (UK PSTI statement) and has historically shipped about 6 major iOS upgrades.

value.reason: 430,000 for leftover PTA stock is close to iPhone 17 Pro Max, which has a newer chip and faster charging.

availability.reason: Only Mega.pk had PTA stock (256GB) on 2026-10-11, and Apple stopped selling it in September 2025.

notes: Apple stopped selling it in September 2025, but Mega.pk still lists the PTA 256GB single SIM at 429,999 as available. Non-PTA: Mega.pk's 512GB dual SIM is available at 344,999 with shop warranty; its non-PTA 256GB units (319,999 and 321,999) are on order only.
